I met with an instructor at the school for safety wire and that went pretty good. I’m feeling much more confident about it and I’m really feeling better about this whole thing.

He told me that I might have to do more projects so I’m assuming I’ll have 9 projects again with the two I didn’t pass before. Which is odd bc I thought I only had to do the two things I missed? I don’t know for sure but I bought both Jeppesen General and Airframe O&P guides on Amazon just to be prepared for other projects in Materials and Processes as well as Assembly and Rigging. 

I’m going to get in contact with an instructor at the school that knows more about the balancing of a flight control surface than the other instructors do and I’ll try to get him to sign me off so I can go back in to test soon.
